title: paymentAmount=0 permits zero-capital extraction of pre-deposited donations
description: No `paymentAmount > 0` guard. Combined with documented donation-flows-forward pattern, an attacker observing a pending donation (sent in error or otherwise) can submit batchMint(count=K, paymentAmount=0) and have the donation cover their mints and refund residue. All realistic donation sources are user/integrator mistakes (C4 known-invalid class), so this is documentation/defense-in-depth rather than direct attack surface.
recommendation: Revert if paymentAmount == 0 OR validate paymentAmount >= expected-cost lower bound.
